intro.fallback: At Zansūru's instruction, the prison guards assault Sasuke throughout the day, punishment for his attack on Menō the night before.
Sasuke doesn't fight back against the guards, instead taking the opportunity to steal a red cloth from one of them.
After his cellmates go to bed, Sasuke ties the cloth to his hand and leaves the cell; because of the cloth, Menō will believe he has permission to be out at night and will leave him alone.

outro.fallback: Jiji is surprised by Sasuke's presence, and is even more surprised when he is told that Sasuke and Sakura are married.
